verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model-hosting and inference API, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or triggered background jobs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no recurring schedules, triggers, or autonomous background automations. Automatic scaling up and down to zero is infrastructure elasticity, an adjacent feature that is not a user-configured automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
